technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot for rapid application setup and embedded server support.
Leverage Spring Cloud Stream for Kafka source and sink module integration.
Use Gradle or Maven for build automation and dependency management.
Implement CI builds using Jenkins or GitHub Actions for Windows environments.
Use AWS SDK for Java to create EC2 AMI with required packages.
Host static gh_pages using GitHub Pages with Jekyll or plain HTML/CSS.
Use Docker containers for Lattice/Diego POC to ensure portability.
Apply Spring's inversion of control and dependency injection patterns throughout.
assumptions: Developers are already familiar with Spring Framework and related tools.
Access to AWS account and permissions to create AMIs is available.
CI infrastructure for Windows builds is partially set up.
Kafka cluster is accessible for performance testing.
Existing codebase and modules are available for extension.
Documentation and sample data are available for reference architectures.
Lattice/Diego environment is accessible for POC development.
Performance testing tools like JMeter or custom scripts are available.

activities.activity_name: Create EC2 AMI with necessary packages
activities.activity_description: Set up an EC2 instance, install required packages for Kafka performance testing, and create an AMI image for reuse.
Develop a Spring Cloud Stream source module that generates load for performance testing use-cases.
Develop a Spring Cloud Stream sink module that receives load and measures received throughput.
Configure CI pipeline to run builds on Windows, isolate test failures, and experiment with new AMI images.

activities.activity_name: Fix offset management with Kafka source module
activities.activity_description: Debug and fix offset management issues in the Kafka source module to enable efficient fetch operations from given offsets.

activities.activity_name: Measure performance numbers for a simple stream
activities.activity_description: Run performance tests on a simple stream and collect throughput and latency metrics.
Set up a static website using GitHub Pages to organize samples, tutorials, links, performance benchmarks, and reference architectures.
Continue proof of concept for Lattice/Diego integration to identify scope, risks, and design for a pluggable SPI in XD runtime.
